baseline: PLMR_Otomatik_Yukleyici_v21.zip, current labels updated to v22
method: Actual local Git repositories: commit, fetch, fast-forward, merge, push, rejection/retry and conflict; Python overlay model; PowerShell flow inspection

tests.test: Existing staged, unstaged, new and deleted repo files auto commit
Deletion in GitHub folder is included in the local checkpoint
Diverged branches merge automatically when edits do not conflict
Local checkpoint and remote-only edits are both preserved
Source updates produce another automatic commit
Preexisting repo edits remain recoverable from pre-copy commit
Missing source image stays in repo and settings are not uploaded
Actual local bare-remote push sends combined commits
Repeated click with no edits creates no empty commit
Failed push preserves local commit and source files
Retry with existing pending commit succeeds without manual commit
Retry publishes saved commit
Remote-only commit fast-forwards automatically
Real conflict aborts owned merge and keeps committed local changes
Production ordering is local checkpoint, fetch/merge, copy, source commit, push
Missing-file lists removed and same-name replacement options retained
No forced push, hard reset or filesystem removal
Incomplete merge/rebase is checked before automatic stage/commit
First setup requests repo/account only when no existing clone/settings
Account guidance and one auth retry are present
Settings contain no password/token fields and are excluded from upload
Production Windows script labels and BOM are v22 only
